model.architecture: lfm2 ShortConv/attention hybrid (14L: 8 conv + 6 GQA attention, hidden 1024, tied embeddings, 65k vocab), general-purpose instruct (non-thinking)

variants.quantization: post-hoc OCTAV int4 blockwise-32 on linears + int8 embedding - IFEval-style strict 53.3% (-6.7pt vs bf16, the size trade); GSM8K 22; 8Q 6/8 cpu + 8/8 gpu

platform_notes: Requires litert-lm >= 0.15 (tested on 0.16.x); same template/shape notes as the int8 file

At 230M the int4/int8 speed ordering is per-device: iPhone Metal decode 162 vs int8's 143 tok/s, but Adreno GPU decode 43 vs int8's 122 (blockwise dequant dominates at this size) and Mac is a wash - pick int4 for size or iPhone, not for Android speed

variants.quantization: post-hoc dynamic int8 on linears + embedding, convs float (export-time conv-int8 costs ~5pt instruction-following on this tune) - IFEval-style strict 58.3% vs bf16 60.0% (paired, indistinguishable); GSM8K 23 = bf16 parity; 8Q 7/8 cpu + 7/8 gpu (bf16 8/8, miss is one rhyme line)

recommended.reason: measured on one Galaxy S26 with one binary (2026-09-01, 205-token prompt, 2 runs per cell): GPU 3814 tok/s prefill / 121.8 decode against CPU 1073 / 95.0, full LITERT_CL delegation, generation verified; peak 444 MB (GPU) vs 636-706 MB (CPU). Same-device CPU control taken - a measured win. The int4 sibling is slower on this GPU (42.6 decode) and the card names int8 the recommended file

measured on one Pixel 8a with one binary (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-05, 205-token prompt, 2 cold runs per backend, cooled before each run): cpu decodes 57.03-58.66 tok/s against gpu's 39.39-41.88 (1.4x), prefill 369.3-445.3 vs 847.0 tok/s, peak 622 vs 1081 MB, engine init 1.2 vs 6.2 s. Same-device GPU control taken - a measured win for cpu on decode. The ordering flips between handsets: on the Galaxy S26's Adreno the GPU decodes 1.3x faster than its CPU (the flagship recommendation), on this Mali phone the CPU decodes faster and needs no compile step, so an 8 GB-class phone should default to cpu

platform_notes: Requires litert-lm >= 0.15 (hybrid conv/KV state binds via ExecutorMetadata; tested on 0.16.x)
Embedded chat template is a render-equivalent repair of the upstream one (minijinja rejects HF {% generation %} markers and map .get) - byte-identical rendering proven across 6 conversation shapes
KV budget 4096 with 11 prefill signatures (1-1024); a 4099 budget fails GPU shader compile against the 1024 signature
Recommended file everywhere except iPhone-Metal-decode-bound deployments: more accurate than int4 and 2.8x faster decode on Adreno GPU
